reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it to go. I have a drawer full of half-used bottles and I'm not adding another one for $25 to $30.
objection: I already have a magnesium bottle at home that I take before bed. A sachet to carry around solves a problem I don't have.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a real problem I have, like cramps after a workout or a trip where I forgot my bottle, and a price close to what I pay now for a month of magnesium.
